init.title: Weather Display
init.description:
Map Home Assistant entities to what the display shows, then set its power schedule. Paste this check-in URL into the device's web page:

`{webhook_url}`

data.location: Location label (blank uses your HA location name)

pd.title: Plant Display
pd.description:
Paste this check-in URL into the display's web page:

`{webhook_url}`

Pick plants from the Plants integration to show them, or leave that empty to set each plant up by hand on the next pages. The grow light shows in the top strip; with "screen follows the light" on, the screen switches off a minute after the light does and wakes on a touch.

data.plants: Plants to show (from the Plants integration)

plant.title: Plant {n}
plant.description: Leave the moisture sensor empty to leave this plant off the display. The name defaults to the sensor's device name. The display shows three plants per page, neediest first.

data.name: Name
data.another: Add another plant after this one
